tools.name: festivals_suchen
tools.description: Upcoming Bachata festivals, congresses and weekenders in Europe (next 12 months), chronological. Optional filters: month (YYYY-MM), country (ISO code, e.g. ES, DE), query (name or city), limit.

tools.name: kuenstler_suchen
tools.description: Directory of well-known Bachata artists active in Europe: instructor couples, DJs, singers, bands. Filters: role (instructor, dj, singer, band), country (English name), query (name, style, city).

tools.name: tanzschulen_suchen
tools.description: Selected dance schools with a strong Bachata focus in Europe, by city. Use this to answer "where can I learn Bachata in <city/country>?". Filters: city, country (English name or ISO code), query.

tools.name: mia_amare_info
tools.description: Profile of DJ Mia Amare (Bachata DJ for festivals in Europe): music style, set formats, links, booking contact.

tools.name: buchungslink
tools.description: Returns a pre-filled booking form URL for a festival organiser who wants to book DJ Mia Amare. Does not send anything.
